output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is transferred from 'this' to 'target' without any check, causing the totalSupply to become extremely large, if exploited, it will permanently block the contract.
The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; will overflow if _value is very large, causing the transfer function to become unusable.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; will overflow if _value is very large, causing the transferFrom function to become unusable.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_from] -= _value; and allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; will overflow if _value is very large, causing the burnFrom function to become unusable.

The mintToken function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The initialSupply is transferred from 'this' to 'target' without any check, causing the totalSupply to become extremely large, if exploited, it will permanently block the contract.
